none.$description: Default for every structural object: cards, labels, tags, tables, code, figures, callouts.

control.$description: Non-button controls: text inputs, selects and keyboard keys. Square, to match structure; kept separate so form controls can change without touching cards.

pill.$description: Buttons and icon-only controls, and nothing else: cx-button (primary, secondary, disabled), the code copy button, the theme toggle and heading anchors. The one rounded shape in the system, so a pill always means something you can press. Never on cards, tags, labels, tooltips, nav items or inputs.

round.$description: Status dots and the toggle thumb only. Never on text containers.
